mechanism: Albendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing torsemide levels; torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) may increase risk of adverse effects and reduce efficacy of concurrent medications.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly during concurrent use; consider potassium supplementation if needed; assess for signs of hypokalemia-related complications.
